run_preprocess_ego4d_narrations: run the preprocess function with mode ego4d_narr to preprocess Ego4D narration data
run_preprocess_ego4d_features: run the preprocess function with mode ego4d_features to preprocess Ego4D feature data
run_preprocess_k400: run the preprocess function with mode k400 to preprocess Kinetics 400 dataset
run_preprocess_ego_charade: run the preprocess function with mode ego_charade to preprocess Ego4D Charades data
run_preprocess_cc: run the preprocess function with mode cc to preprocess Conceptual Captions data
